## Receive command, check & update
Only changes posts that are **Chờ duyệt** (pending approval): approve → **Chờ đăng** (scheduled), drop → **Đã bỏ** (dropped). Logs the time in Notes and replies in the group.
**/duyet** is the final step: approval only when the post has a main image and a Zalo OA cover made from the current image.
